rules.note: Explicit narrow preferred contexts; Common Stock/Shares suppresses.
Non-cumulative plus explicit financial context; Common Stock/Shares suppresses.

ordered_guard_spec: Suppress N03 on Common Units or Corporate Units unless name explicitly contains Acquisition or SPAC. That exception is heuristic, not verified SPAC status; flag for manual review.
Suppress N04,N05,N08,N09 on Common Stock or Common Shares. N08/N09 have this extra conservative guard to protect issuer operating stock.
Suppress N08 on exact Invesco LTD/Limited/Inc issuer company name. No symbol override.

V3 N08: suppress issuer-brand rule on Inc/Corp/Corporation/Ltd/Limited unless Fund/ETF/ETN exists, or Trust together with Shares/Series/Portfolio. Common Stock/Shares guard remains for N08/N09. N10 is separate positive crypto product context, not a blanket removal of Common Stock guard.
V3 N10: known crypto brand plus explicit Trust/TR/ETF/ETN/Fund; suppress UNIT component rule. Osprey Acquisition and CoinShares operating ordinary shares do not satisfy product context.
V3 N11: exact Income [Builder] [Opportunities] Trust / Opportunities Trust / Micro-Cap Trust phrases; reject mortgage/realty/REIT/bank/property names and preferred descriptions. No Trust-alone rule.
Using remaining matched types: UNIT suppresses N01/N02/N04; ADR suppresses N02; ETF_ETN_FUND suppresses N05.
ETF_ETN_FUND/WARRANT/UNIT suppress N07; then remaining ADR suppresses N04.
Choose first surviving rule for primary display, retain every surviving rule and every suppressed rule with reason. Unknown passes type filter only.
